purpose: Task-balanced target-local LoRA activation-effect distillation on detached policy-native inputs from the retained v13 model, before any simulator outcome macro.

information_wall.held5: privileged transform and frozen inference only; zero shared gradient and zero code fitting
q_pi_inputs: exact language and action-hidden correct-video event anchors
full successful-occupancy eight-phase source-subtracted action response
successful and learner occupancy full-layer source/expert owner responses
detached source target inputs and successful-member target-local LoRA activation effects
source, stable-shared and learner-policy counterfactual responses

model.prior_only_surface: exact complete rank16 gauge-canonical stable shared prior
model.full_process_surface: process-value-only bounded rank-one retraction from every canonical shared mode toward a content-conditioned replacement mode
model.rank_selector: content-derived per-target per-rank angle, bounded by pi over two
model.replacement_normalization: FP32 QR directions with per-target RMS canonical-shared factor energy; raw head amplitude cannot affect the output
model.q_pi_gate: member x event x owner content gate, bounded by visible event presence
model.program_content: owner/layer/family are tensor addresses; no additive address embeddings in visible Program values or q_pi factor values
model.compiler_content_path: language and scene condition target-rank queries; only present ordered process and uncertainty tokens provide selector and replacement Values
model.query_content_modulation: language-scene-conditioned target/rank query multiplicatively modulates process-only Values; zero process content leaves shared unchanged even when presence is nonzero
model.replacement_head_init_basis: factor heads initialize replacement directions only; QR removes their raw amplitude

data.video_sampling: without replacement deterministic per task visit
data.phase_source: fit19-frozen 350-to-32 whitening of complete 50x7 successful trajectory responses
data.learner_states: 30 frozen fit19 projected-policy trajectories; verified successes full weight and failures member-agreement/outcome weighted

policy_support.horizon_compression: orthonormal DCT low-frequency basis over complete 50-token owner projection and detached target inputs

objective.effective_update: diagnostic-only exact gauge-invariant BA Frobenius distance; zero optimization weight
objective.canonical_factor_warmstart: diagnostic-only compact rank16 SVD gauge distance; zero optimization weight
objective.functional_response: paired complete PI0.5 final-flow plus target-local LoRA activation effects on alternating successful and learner multi-phase occupancy
objective.target_local_activation_effect: candidate and successful members apply each target B(Ax_ref) to the same detached source input in 38-owner x 4-horizon-basis policy-native output spaces
objective.prior_counterfactual: language and scene never act as replacement Values; absent or zero process content returns the exact stable-prior LoRA

optimization.task_balance_contract: Each 114-visit block contains exactly six visits for every fit task; rows remain cost-balanced within the block.
optimization.distributed: manual flat gradient mean, deferred NCCL, task-equal

materialization.sampling: fixed correct action-hidden videos without replacement
materialization.output: one privileged q_pi consensus rank16 LoRA per task

gate2.failure_action: stop before q_V; repair the earliest q_pi/compiler/support interface instead of tuning rank, seed, dtype, or tiny LR sweeps
